product_claim: Selected PIV data-model assertions with deterministic synthetic evidence; no complete current-standard card verdict

gaps.detail: Decompose and deduplicate all applicable final requirements, including tables and incorporated material. Review PIV/profile/applicability before establishing any denominator. 1318 source locators and 28 group/gap records are not that denominator.
All four databases and their referenced methods are indexed. Full per-row source, applicability, assertion-dominance and delta review is still incomplete; known findings are recorded separately.

CHUID CMS, signed attributes, signature verification, Security Object LDS hashes/DG correspondence, unsigned-object completeness and signer relationships need current assertions and positive/negative evidence.

Full PKIX certificate extensions/policies, key-use-specific constraints, certificate relationships, validity, revocation and issuer/content-signer key/hash restrictions remain. AlgorithmIdentifier checks and synthetic local paths do not prove these.

Only selected mandatory fingerprint CBEFF header fields are proven. Fingerprint minutiae, face/iris/OCC payloads, CBEFF signatures, acquisition/quality and incorporated format requirements need review and evidence. Leap-second date encoding is not established by current header vectors.

Government email, retired-key state, VCI/OCC/global PIN and other profile inputs must determine mandatory presence. Current optional entry points abort on absence. Discovery, BIT, CVC and other cross-object links remain incomplete.

Legacy APDUConstants strings for retired slots 5-10 and 15-20 use incorrect OID arcs. Candidate structure checks currently use those internal aliases; wire-tag and normative OID interoperability are not proven.

Available local history/artifacts and all 21 published release assets were searched. Matching original certificates remain encrypted and were not used. Synthetic generic path/policy vectors are not full semantic equivalents of the historical federal paths; 24 historical external tests still fail for missing files.

140 historical reference rows indexed, 87 different-scope rows classified, six differences reviewed. Four pure UUID helper inputs were executed. Complete behavioral comparison of 53 data-model rows and current requirement mapping remains.
Discovery AID length conflict, post-2030 transition semantics and exact current PIV-I profile remain in decisions.json. Security Object maxima were resolved from final text and implemented.

APDU/status/access-control, PIN/OCC/VCI, secure messaging, key generation and CMVP/CAVP/acquisition claims require separate evidence. No hardware or PIN tests were run; Part3 middleware qualification is out of scope.

resolved_items.detail: Swing now maps candidate aborts to SKIP, preserving historical abort-as-FAIL behavior. Four dedicated regression checks pass. This does not establish conditional applicability or a full card verdict.
